Note: Arm A = Patients with indications for which a CPI is indicated/approved; Arm B = Patients with tumor types for which CPI
therapy is not indicated/approved.
[a] Duration of exposure = (the date of last WTX-330 does - the date of first WTX-330 dose + 14)/7.
[b] Cumulative Dose of WTX-330 (mg/kg) = sum of the individual Total Dose Administered being reported in CRFs.
[c] Average Dose Intensity ((mg/kg)/cycle) is calculated by Cumulative Dose /Number of treatment cycles started.
[d] Treatment compliance (%) = 100*(Cumulative Dose/Total Planned Dose).
[e] Categories are not mutually exclusive.
